title: A new class of Euler explosions
summary: We study the global-in-time continuation, past the singularity, of the smooth, non-isentropic, radially symmetric imploding solutions of the compressible Euler equations recently constructed by Chen, Shkoller, and Vicol. In three space dimensions, for all physically relevant adiabatic exponents $γ>1$, we consider the Euler solution that evolves smoothly until an implosion singularity forms at the origin at time $t=0$.
